This charming 3 bedroom flat is located in Buarcos, Figueira da Foz, very close to the beach and offers superb views of the sea.

Close to all kinds of shops and services, it is an excellent choice for either permanent housing or holidays.

With a south / west orientation, this flat is excellent for those looking to live within the city, with comfort and tranquillity.

The private area is well separated from the social area and is presented as follows:

- Three spacious bedrooms, with fitted wardrobes, with plenty of natural light and sea views

- A guest toilet and a private toilet in one of the bedrooms

- Large and bright living room with sun exposure to the west, with direct access to a spacious terrace perfect for organising events and enjoying leisure time with family and friends, while admiring the blue of the sea or a fabulous sunset.

- Spacious and very functional kitchen equipped with induction hob, oven, extractor fan, dishwasher, washing machine and a combined fridge 

- Private terrace: The ideal place to enjoy al fresco dining and relax, with magnificent sea views

- Closed garage

This property also has a fireplace in the living room and pre-installation of air conditioning
